parent_objective: materialize a no-training controller-family decisive matrix protocol preflight
blocked_by: need machine-readable matrix protocol before any training or replay
supersedes: direct one-seed matrix pilot after M1670

public_gates: M1671 must not train or replay policies
M1671 must verify all 12 corrected profile configs exist
M1671 must verify standard profile, clean package, and artifact-failure summaries are readable
M1671 must write a machine-readable matrix protocol
M1671 must keep private holdout, promotion, PPO, actor-input changes, and level3 claims blocked
forbidden_shortcuts: do not repair the M1663 artifact
do not run a one-seed pilot

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: creates a no-training protocol artifact for the controller-family decisive evidence matrix
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: infrastructure preflight only; no training, replay, PPO, promotion, private holdout, paper-level or level3 claim
stop_condition: stop if any corrected profile config is missing
stop if clean package or standard profile artifacts cannot be read
stop if the protocol treats public proof rows as private holdout
stop if protocol creation requires actor input changes or profile-specific tuning
fallback_plan: route to config repair if profiles are missing or stale
route to artifact audit if M1615 or M1497 summaries are unreadable
route to task-source design if clean package cannot be mapped honestly
route back to M1670 design audit if protocol assumptions conflict with the claim ladder
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1670 admits one no-training protocol preflight

admission_evidence: M1670 defines controller families, evidence layers, metrics, and stop rules
M1670 blocks training and replay until a machine-readable protocol exists
allowed_updates: M1671 status queue scoreboard research log and review

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: high; preflight must preserve current-response and current-tiled controls as first-class matrix entries.
history_necessity_tests: protocol must include L2 current-tiled controls
protocol must keep reset zero-current zero-action wrong-history and delayed-history metrics separated where later applicable
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M1670 design and referenced public artifacts only.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If preflight finds the clean package is L3-specific, route to task-source regeneration rather than forcing a self-ID claim.
allowed_claims: no training, no replay, no PPO, no private-holdout, no paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: A no-training preflight can materialize the controller-family decisive matrix protocol and verify required configs and artifacts before any costly run.
success_criteria: all 12 corrected profile configs are accounted for
M1497 standard profile summary is readable
M1615 clean package summary is readable
training replay PPO promotion private holdout actor-input changes and level3 claims remain blocked
failure_criteria: protocol treats public rows as private holdout
training replay PPO promotion private holdout or actor-input changes occur

commands.name: preflight
commands.command: create or run no-training controller-family decisive matrix protocol preflight

decision_rule: M1671 passes if it materializes the matrix protocol and verifies config/artifact availability without training, replay, PPO, promotion, private holdout, or actor-input changes.
